_doc: Known, unresolved semantic issues. Each entry lists the exact affected cases; acceptance.py fails if the observed set differs in any way. Updating this file is a reviewed decision, not a way to pass the gate.

uncertified.rationale: No supported violation, but at least one required final state is unproven (mostly the primary account: not identified, or several unowned workflow candidates). Serialised as INCOMPLETE with future checks only; the contract has no status for this (case_investigation.md section 1, organiser Q4/Q5).

incomplete_without_findings.rationale: the uncertified cases above, seen by the independent verifier as INCOMPLETE rows without a finding

incomplete_empty_plan.rationale: case_04: no admissible evidence names any resource of the subject (conflict C3); the only empty INCOMPLETE row in any output; not present in the 518 output

incomplete_without_findings.rationale: uncertified samples: the account is one of several unowned workflow candidates (conflict C4); gold certifies COMPLETE

resource_not_discoverable_by_audit_at.rationale: gold sample steps that name resources not discoverable by audit_at: post-cutoff files (C1: case_09/23/24/29/30) or no file at all (C2: case_18/20, C3: case_04)

transcript.rationale: agent-trace.zip holds this session's JSONL after a context compaction; turns before the compaction are summarised at its start, not present verbatim. log.txt has an entry for every turn; entries written after the fact are marked '(recorded late)'. /export was not available in this harness.
